title: Man breaks Nashville McDonald’s employee’s arm after being asked to leave for making female worker uncomfortable
text:
NASHVILLE, Tenn. (WSMV) - A man was arrested after police say he broke an employee’s arm at a Nashville McDonald’s.

According to an arrest affidavit, Metro Nashville Police first encountered Javaunn Brown at a bus stop near the 8th Ave. South McDonald’s, where he told them that he had been harassed by workers “for no reason at all.”

Police then spoke with McDonald’s employees, who said Brown had been flirting with a cashier and making her uncomfortable.

When the woman’s coworker Ethan Caldwell saw her discomfort, he told police he asked her to go to the back of the restaurant and he told Brown that they were closing and he would have to leave.

Caldwell then followed Brown to the door so that he could lock it once he left. He was about to do so when the affidavit says that “Brown pulled the door hard and fast causing Mr. Caldwell to break his right arm, requiring surgery.” Caldwell was transported to the hospital due to severe pain.

Brown is now being charged with aggravated assault.
